login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your FLOX workspace.

signup.title: Create your workspace
signup.description: One workspace per organization — you'll be its Owner.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Click it to activate your workspace.
checkEmail.resendSuccess: If that email has a pending verification, a new link is on its way.

verifyEmail.successDescriptionLoggedIn: You're all set — taking you to your workspace…
verifyEmail.successDescriptionLoginRequired: Your email is confirmed. Sign in to continue.
verifyEmail.invalidDescription: This verification link is invalid or has expired. Enter your email to get a new one.

acceptInvite.title: Join {{organizationName}}
acceptInvite.description: You've been invited as {{role}}. Set your name and a password to finish joining.
acceptInvite.invalidDescription: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask whoever invited you to resend it.

totp.codeDescription: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for this account.
totp.backupCodeHint: Lost access to your authenticator? Enter one of your backup codes instead.
totp.enrollDescription: Your organization requires two-factor authentication. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter a code to finish.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for two-factor authentication setup
totp.backupCodesHint: Each code works once, if you ever lose access to your authenticator. They won't be shown again.

methodHint.email: A code to your account's email at every sign-in.
methodHint.sms: A code to your phone at every sign-in.

twoFactor.smsUnavailable: SMS is not configured on this deployment.
twoFactor.phoneHint: International format with the country code, e.g. +7 900 123-45-67.
twoFactor.appInstructions: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.codeSentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {{to}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.

codeDescription.email: We sent a 6-digit code to {{to}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
codeDescription.sms: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {{to}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.

twoFactor.backupCodeHint: No access to the code? Enter one of your backup codes instead.
twoFactor.backupCodesHint: Each code works once, if you ever lose access to your second factor. They become yours once you confirm, and won't be shown again.
twoFactor.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
twoFactor.enrollDescription: Your organization requires two-factor authentication. Choose how you will confirm sign-ins.
